reviews.text: Great local pet store
You need to be open longer!! This is the only pet store my cat will eat food from and I do not have enough time to make it here after work.
Carol is the most helpful person I’ve ever encountered in retail! She goes well above and beyond any expectations. Thanks Carol :)
Thanks!
Citalli and Carol run a great shop! Clean, local, open convenient hours and have what we need for our dog. Top shelf!!
Carol has been so helpful, knowledgeable and kind for years. Pet Pantry is a small shop but well stocked with the food and supplies I need for my pet. Highly recommended!
So wonderful to have a pet shop in the neighbourhood with everything I need as well as friendly service and staff who know me.
Very nice pet store in the neighborhood great, attentive and friendly staff 100% shop here again. Cool selection of different dogs and cats brands

I’ve been shopping here for years now. It’s the best pet shop with the most helpful and friendly staff. Carol has always gone above and beyond to help me and my wife with all of our pet needs. Thank you very much. Easy 5 stars highly recommend.
I come about once a week and the lady who owns it (I think) is super sweet and always helpful
Reliable, friendly, good product line
Bad rastruant service

I bought a souvenir for my dog ​​who was staying home in Vancouver, Canada.
The size was a perfect fit.
I also bought a replacement brush here, which was replacing a broken one.
It's well-made and I'm very satisfied.
Thank you very much.
five star awesome
Great selection online, reasonable prices, and free local delivery.
Excellent service, competitive prices, they deliver & if it’s not in stock they will source it!
My go to local store but they also deliver to my home
Found a great kitty litter and great service! Appreciate that they remember who you are!

Well organized. Items are well spread out and easy to find. They have a massive selection of frozen raw food, which is fantastic for me. It's great to have a massive selection because my cat has very odd allergies. It's great that I can grab him different types of meat for him to try (although he prefers pork anyway)

It's central to a lot of grocery stores so it's very convenient.

Plus, it is very close to the bus line and skytrain. The lady who I think is the manager or owner is very kind and helpful. I give it five stars because I can't think of anything negative.
Favourite pet food store ever! Staff are also so nice and insightful

great store to visit with your dog! Lara is incredibly helpful every time I come with my dog.

Thanks for all the treats!
Friendly staff and local delivery.
